message.content:
1: Just at sundown (independent clause)  
2: when his day’s work was ended (dependent clause - adverbial)  
3: he took a quantity of unwhitened rice (independent clause)  
4: which was the principal food for the poor (dependent clause - relative)  
5: and he cooked, dried it (independent clause)  
6: and tied it in a square cloth (independent clause)  
7: which he swung in a bundle around his neck (dependent clause - relative)  
8: along with a gourd filled with cool, sweet water (independent clause)
